confirmation.selection: One frozen candidate; no confirmation-driven tuning, dropped attempts or replacement captures.

windowed.purpose: Actual windowed Godot integration; full RPC reporting separates finishing request from ordinary control. Single pair is not a latency guarantee.

effective_thread_count: Not measured; one worker is not a claim of a single native BLAS thread.

accuracy.rgb: Exact decoded uint8 RGB plus PNG CRC/bounds; compressed bytes and consequent hashes/sizes may differ.
accuracy.depth: Exact NPY bytes and float32 values.
accuracy.native: Exact arrays/dtypes/commands and independent scorer; no tolerance.
accuracy.perception: Exact estimates/masks/acquisition ages, excluding processing wall-time only.
accuracy.normalization: Validate each original integrity, configuration binding and frame reference before excluding source implementation hashes and PNG encoding-derived hashes/sizes. All configuration fields and source-key inventories remain equal.

metrics: profile-only PNG and durable file writing attribution (overlapping scopes)
actual capture bytes and frame bytes
offline frame-processing wall age (not sensor/hardware age)
windowed RPC/server-step times with finishing request separate
scope: Simulated PiPER small authored arm path above a rigid block, no learned policy, physical commands or successful placement claim. No new human demonstration or 50Hz hardware deadline claim.
publication: Reviewed source and compact evidence as GitHub draft; no raw footage or credentials. Other channels only after supported artifact readiness.
